newsitem.title: USA: Verilink options to start trading July 18.
newsitem.headline: Verilink options to start trading July 18.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Friday they would begin trading options on shares of Verilink Corp on July 18.
The exchanges said the otions will have opening strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2. Initial expirations have been set for August, September, October and January.
The stock was down 1/4 at 10-1/2 Friday afternoon.
At the AMEX and PCX, position limits of 10,500 contracts have been set.

Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist for the options at the AMEX. At the PCX, the options have been allocated to lead market makers Matthew Zahner, Michael Resch and Martin Resch. Athena Trading LLC has been named the designated primary market maker (DPM) for the options at the CBOE.
